title: Global well-posedness and Decay estimates for solutions of the Navier--Stokes--Maxwell system
summary: We investigate the global solvability and the large-time asymptotic behavior of solutions to the Navier--Stokes--Maxwell system in two and three space dimensions. The system describes the interaction between a viscous incompressible fluid and an electromagnetic field through the Lorenz force and Ohm's law. The system exhibits a parabolic--hyperbolic coupling in which the dissipative Navier--Stokes system interacts with the hyperbolic Maxwell system.
